column1: # path<TAB>job<TAB>backlog digest<TAB>reason. Only relay-backlog keys frozen
# in the checker may appear; no pull_request job may be listed.
# Relay backlog (#1831). Jobs a relay event (workflow_dispatch, workflow_call,
# repository_dispatch) reaches that can resolve to a persistent runner, present
# before ADR 0235 scanned relays. The digest here is the backlog digest:
# SHA-256 over the job's full content, its callers, its inherited settings,
# the bytes of every local action it runs, and its unresolved reason names, so
# any edit to the job makes the row stop applying. The keys are
# frozen in public-pr-runner-isolation.py (RELAY_BACKLOG), which also names
# the refusal kinds each tolerated then; refusals are decided before this list
# is read. No row may be added; each leaves by moving to the ephemeral lane or,
# when head detection finds no pattern, by gaining a reviewed entry.
